title: Practice 2: Rain falls, time flies, luck comes: the idioms

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.q: Это судно ___ (везти — to convey by vehicle, one way) хлопок-сырец.
exercises.why: **везёт** — present tense (3rd person singular) of везти: one-direction verb (many directions: возить).
exercises.prompt: The ship is carrying raw cotton.

exercises.q: Том ___ (вести — to lead, take along, one way) себя как детсадовец.
exercises.why: **ведёт** — present tense (3rd person singular) of вести: one-direction verb (many directions: водить).
exercises.prompt: Tom has been behaving like a kindergarten kid.

exercises.q: Он ___ (вести — to lead, take along, one way) себя как большая шишка.
exercises.why: **ведет** — present tense (3rd person singular) of вести: one-direction verb (many directions: водить).
exercises.prompt: He acts like a big shot.

exercises.q: Люди не всегда ___ (вести — to lead, take along, one way) себя рационально.
exercises.why: **ведут** — present tense (3rd person plural) of вести: one-direction verb (many directions: водить).

exercises.q: Это вы ___ (вести — to lead, take along, one way) себя неподобающим образом.
exercises.why: **вели** — past tense (plural) of вести: one-direction verb (many directions: водить).
exercises.prompt: You're the ones who have acted inappropriately.

exercises.q: Люди не всегда ___ (вести — to lead, take along, one way) себя благоразумно.
exercises.why: **ведут** — present tense (3rd person plural) of вести: one-direction verb (many directions: водить).

exercises.q: Обычно Том ___ (носить — to carry on foot, there and back or in general) очки.
exercises.why: **носит** — present tense (3rd person singular) of носить: many-directions verb (one direction: нести).

exercises.q: Том часто ___ (носить — to carry on foot, there and back or in general) шляпу.
exercises.why: **носит** — present tense (3rd person singular) of носить: many-directions verb (one direction: нести).

exercises.q: Мне катастрофически не ___ (везти — to convey by vehicle, one way) с женщинами.
exercises.why: **везёт** — present tense (3rd person singular) of везти: one-direction verb (many directions: возить).
exercises.prompt: I have the worst luck with women.

exercises.q: Автобус ___ (везти — to convey by vehicle, one way) много огнеопасных материалов.
exercises.why: **везёт** — present tense (3rd person singular) of везти: one-direction verb (many directions: возить).
exercises.prompt: The bus carries a lot of inflammable materials.

exercises.q: Том сказал, что я ___ (вести — to lead, take along, one way) себя безответственно.
exercises.why: **веду** — present tense (1st person singular) of вести: one-direction verb (many directions: водить).
exercises.prompt: Tom said I was being irresponsible.

exercises.q: Ты не достоин ___ (носить — to carry on foot, there and back or in general) форму.
exercises.prompt: You're not fit to wear the shirt.

exercises.q: ___ (ходить — to go, walk, there and back or in general) слухи, что Мэри – колдунья.
exercises.why: **ходят** — present tense (3rd person plural) of ходить: many-directions verb (one direction: идти).
exercises.prompt: Rumor has it that Mary is a witch.

exercises.q: Он ___ (носить — to carry on foot, there and back or in general) очки в чёрной оправе.
exercises.why: **носит** — present tense (3rd person singular) of носить: many-directions verb (one direction: нести).

exercises.q: Том ___ (носить — to carry on foot, there and back or in general) очки в чёрной оправе.
exercises.why: **носит** — present tense (3rd person singular) of носить: many-directions verb (one direction: нести).

exercises.q: Дождь ___ (идти — to go, walk, one way) почти стеной. Нам пришлось переместиться, чтобы остаться сухими.
exercises.why: **шёл** — past tense (masculine) of идти: one-direction verb (many directions: ходить).
exercises.prompt: The rain was almost horizontal. We had to move elsewhere to stay dry.

exercises.q: Напоминаю, что Вы ___ (нести — to carry on foot, one way) ответственность за дачу заведомо ложных показаний.
exercises.why: **несёте** — present tense (2nd person plural) of нести: one-direction verb (many directions: носить).
exercises.prompt: Remember that you are held liable for giving deliberately false testimony.
